phrases.ar: أَيۡنَمَا تَكُونُواْ يُدۡرِككُّمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ وَلَوۡ كُنتُمۡ فِي بُرُوجٖ مُّشَيَّدَةٖۗ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ حَسَنَةٞ يَقُولُواْ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٞ يَقُولُواْ هَٰذِهِۦ مِنۡ عِندِكَۚ
phrases.translation: Wherever you may be, death will overcome you—even if you were in fortified towers.” When something good befalls them, they say, “This is from Allah,” but when something evil befalls them, they say, “This is from you.” Say, ˹O
phrases.explanation: "Wherever you may be, death will overcome you, even if you were in fortified towers. But if something good comes to them, they say, This is from Allah, and if something bad befalls them, they say, This is from you. Say, All is from Allah. So what is with these people that they can hardly understand any statement?" Allah says death will seize everyone wherever they are, even in strong towers, for death does not miss anyone. And He addresses the hypocrites who attribute good to Allah and evil to the Messenger, saying all is from Allah. And the exegetes discussed the towers and said they are the strongholds, and death comes even there, and the attribution of good and evil is all from Allah, for He decrees all things, and He knows what is best, and He is All-Knowing of the hypocrites who say evil is from the Messenger. And the believer should not attribute evil to anyone but say all is from Allah, for the good and the evil are by His decree, and He tests His servants with both, and the patient will be rewarded, and Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who says all is from Allah sincerely, and He will requite the patient, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to those who turn to Him.

phrases.ar: قُلۡ كُلّٞ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَمَالِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ حَدِيثٗا
phrases.translation: Prophet,˺ “Both have been destined by Allah.” So what is the matter with these people? They can hardly comprehend anything
phrases.explanation: "Say, All is from Allah. So what is with these people that they can hardly understand any statement?" Everything, good and evil, is from Allah by His decree, and the hypocrites hardly understand because of their weak intellect and their turning away, and Allah is All-Knowing of them, and He will requite them, and the believer should say all is from Allah in good and in affliction. And the believer accepts the decree of Allah in good and in affliction, and says all is from Allah, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise, and He knows what is best for His servants, and He will reward the patient with Paradise.

phrases.ar: مَّآ أَصَابَكَ مِنۡ حَسَنَةٖ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِۖ وَمَآ أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٖ فَمِن نَّفۡسِكَۚ
phrases.translation: Whatever good befalls you is from Allah and whatever evil befalls you is from yourself. We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ as a
phrases.explanation: "Whatever good befalls you is from Allah and whatever evil befalls you is from yourself. We have sent you as a Messenger for the people, and Allah is sufficient as Witness." Allah says all good that befalls you is from Him, and all evil that befalls you is from your own self, because of your sin. And He sent the Prophet as a Messenger to the people, and Allah is sufficient as Witness over them, seeing their obedience and disobedience. And the exegetes discussed the attribution of evil to the self and said it is because the sin is from the servant, and Allah decrees it, and the believer should say all is from Allah while knowing his sin is from himself, and he should repent, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Seeing.

phrases.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولٗاۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدٗا
phrases.translation: messenger to ˹all˺ people. And Allah is sufficient as a Witness
phrases.explanation: "We have sent you as a Messenger for the people, and Allah is sufficient as Witness." Allah is sufficient as Witness over the people, seeing what they do, and He will requite the obedient and the disobedient, and no one is hidden from Him. And He sees the obedience and the disobedience, and He knows what is hidden in the hearts, and He will requite everyone according to his deed, and the Messenger is a witness over the people too, and Allah is sufficient as Witness, and He does not wrong anyone, and the believer should seek His forgiveness for his sins. And He is All-Just. And He knows all.

phrases.ar: مَّن يُطِعِ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدۡ أَطَاعَ ٱللَّهَۖ وَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظٗا
phrases.translation: Whoever obeys the Messenger has truly obeyed Allah. But whoever turns away, then ˹know that˺ We have not sent you ˹O Prophet˺ as a keeper over them
phrases.explanation: "Whoever obeys the Messenger has truly obeyed Allah. But whoever turns away, then We have not sent you as a keeper over them." Allah says whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah, for the Messenger conveys from Allah, and obeying him is obeying Allah. But whoever turns away, the Prophet was not sent as a keeper over them, to compel them, for Allah guides whom He wills. And the exegetes said the verse is a consolation to the Prophet that he is not responsible for the guidance of those who turn away, and Allah is All-Knowing of who obeys and who turns away, and He will judge between them, and the obedient will be rewarded.

phrases.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ طَاعَةٞ فَإِذَا بَرَزُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ بَيَّتَ طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِي تَقُولُۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَكۡتُبُ مَا يُبَيِّتُونَۖ فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
phrases.translation: And they say, “We obey,” but when they leave you, a group of them would spend the night contradicting what they said. Allah records all their schemes. So turn away from them, and put your trust in Allah. And Allah is sufficient as a Trustee of Affairs
phrases.explanation: "And they say, We obey, but when they leave you, a group of them would plan by night what they say not. Allah records their planning. So turn away from them and put your trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee." Allah says the hypocrites say we obey in the presence of the Messenger, but when they leave, a group plans by night what contradicts what they said, and Allah records their planning, and He will requite them for it. So the Prophet should turn away from them and trust in Allah, and Allah is sufficient as Trustee, protecting the believers from the hypocrites. And the exegetes said the night planning is their secret plotting against the Muslims, and Allah knows it and will expose them on the Day of Judgment. And put your trust in Allah, and do not fear the hypocrites. And He is All-Powerful over them.

phrases.ar: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۚ وَلَوۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ غَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ لَوَجَدُواْ فِيهِ ٱخۡتِلَٰفٗا كَثِيرٗا
phrases.translation: Do they not then reflect on the Quran? Had it been from anyone other than Allah, they would have certainly found in it many inconsistencies
phrases.explanation: "Do they not then reflect on the Quran? Had it been from anyone other than Allah, they would have found in it many contradictions." Allah invites reflection on the Quran, for had it been from other than Allah, they would have found many contradictions in it, but it is from Allah, free of contradiction. And the exegetes said the reflection is pondering its meanings, and the absence of contradiction is a proof of its divine origin, and Allah is All-Knowing of the truth, and He challenges the disbelievers to find a contradiction and they cannot. And ponder its meanings, for the Quran is the word of Allah, and Allah is All-Knowing of what is true, and He has made it clear for those who reflect.

phrases.ar: وَإِذَا جَآءَهُمۡ أَمۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡنِ أَوِ ٱلۡخَوۡفِ أَذَاعُواْ بِهِۦۖ وَلَوۡ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِلَىٰٓ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِ مِنۡهُمۡ لَعَلِمَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَنۢبِطُونَهُۥ مِنۡهُمۡۗ وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ لَٱتَّبَعۡتُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
phrases.translation: And when they hear news of security or fear, they publicize it. Had they referred it to the Messenger or their authorities, those with sound judgment among them would have validated it. Had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy, you would have followed Satan—except for a few
phrases.explanation: "And when they hear news of security or fear, they publicize it. Had they referred it to the Messenger and those in authority among them, those who are able to draw conclusions would have known it. Had it not been for Allah's grace and mercy upon you, you would have followed Satan except for a few." Allah says when news of security or fear comes to the hypocrites, they publicize it without verifying, but had they referred it to the Messenger and the authorities among them, those able to investigate would have known the truth. And Allah says: had it not been for His grace and mercy, you would have followed Satan except a few. So verify the news before spreading it, and refer matters to those in authority, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise, and He has favored you with grace and mercy, so be grateful and follow the truth.

phrases.ar: فَقَٰتِلۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُكَلَّفُ إِلَّا نَفۡسَكَۚ وَحَرِّضِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَكُفَّ بَأۡسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ وَٱللَّهُ أَشَدُّ بَأۡسٗا وَأَشَدُّ تَنكِيلٗا
phrases.translation: So fight in the cause of Allah ˹O Prophet˺. You are accountable for none but yourself. And motivate the believers ˹to fight˺, so perhaps Allah will curb the disbelievers’ might. And Allah is far superior in might and in punishment
phrases.explanation: "So fight in the cause of Allah, O Prophet. You are accountable for none but yourself, and encourage the believers. Perhaps Allah will restrain the might of the disbelievers, for Allah is the Strongest in might and in punishment." Allah commands the Prophet to fight in His cause, and he is accountable only for himself, not for others, and he should encourage the believers to fight, and perhaps Allah will restrain the might of the disbelievers, for He is the strongest in might and the most severe in punishment. And the exegetes said the verse consoles the Prophet that he is not responsible if the believers do not fight, and he should encourage them, and Allah is All-Powerful, and He will aid the believers and defeat the disbelievers, and He knows who fights sincerely.

phrases.ar: مَّن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن يَشۡفَعۡ شَفَٰعَةٗ سَيِّئَةٗ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفۡلٞ مِّنۡهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ
phrases.translation: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a share in the reward, and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a share in the burden.
phrases.explanation: "Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a share in the reward, and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a share in the burden. Allah is ever Watchful over all things." Allah says whoever intercedes for a good cause, like praying for a believer or helping him, will have a share of the reward, and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a share of the sin. So intercede only for good, and Allah is ever Watchful over all things, seeing the intercession and the intention behind it, and He will requite everyone according to it. And the exegetes discussed the intercession and said it includes the intercession on the Day of Judgment, which is for the Prophet and the believers, and the share in the reward is for the good intercession.

phrases.ar: مُّقِيتٗا
phrases.translation: And Allah is Watchful over all things
phrases.explanation: "Allah is ever Watchful over all things." He watches the intercession and the intention, and He knows who intercedes for good and who for evil, and He will requite each. And He sees the good intercession and the evil one, and He knows the intention of the intercessor, and He will give the share of reward to the one who intercedes for good, and the share of sin to the one who intercedes for evil, and Allah is Watchful over all things, and He does not wrong anyone, and the believers should intercede for good and seek the reward of Allah. And He is All-Seeing. And He knows the hearts.

phrases.ar: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٖ فَحَيُّواْ بِأَحۡسَنَ مِنۡهَآ أَوۡ رُدُّوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَسِيبًا
phrases.translation: And when you are greeted, respond with a better greeting or at least similarly. Surely Allah is a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner of all things
phrases.explanation: "And when you are greeted with a greeting, respond with a better greeting or at least similarly. Allah is indeed Accountable for all things." Allah commands that when someone greets you with the salam, respond with a better greeting or return it similarly, for that is good manners and brotherhood. And Allah is Accountable for all things, taking account of the greeting and the response, and He will requite the one who greets well and the one who withholds. And the exegetes said the greeting is the salam of Islam, and responding better is to add to it, and Allah knows the hearts, and He loves the kind.

phrases.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ لَيَجۡمَعَنَّكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۗ وَمَنۡ أَصۡدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حَدِيثٗا
phrases.translation: Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He will certainly gather ˹all of˺ you together on the Day of Judgment—about which there is no doubt. And whose word is more truthful than Allah’s
phrases.explanation: "Allah, there is no god worthy of worship except Him. He will certainly gather you together on the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. And who is more truthful than Allah in speech?" Allah swears by Himself that there is no god but He, and He will gather all people on the Day of Resurrection for reckoning, about which there is no doubt. And who is more truthful in speech than Allah, for He never breaks His promise. And the exegetes said the gathering is the raising from the graves, and the truthfulness of Allah is in His news and His promise, and the believer should believe in the Resurrection and prepare for it, for Allah is All-Knowing and He does not wrong anyone.

phrases.ar: ۞ فَمَا لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ فِئَتَيۡنِ وَٱللَّهُ أَرۡكَسَهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوٓاْۚ أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَهۡدُواْ مَنۡ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُۖ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلٗا
phrases.translation: Why are you ˹believers˺ divided into two groups regarding the hypocrites while Allah allowed them to regress ˹to disbelief˺ because of their misdeeds? Do you wish to guide those left by Allah to stray? And whoever Allah leaves to stray, you will never find for them a way
phrases.explanation: "Why are you believers divided into two groups regarding the hypocrites while Allah has brought them back to disbelief for their deeds? Do you want to guide those whom Allah has let go astray? And whoever Allah lets go astray, you will never find for him a guide. They are the ones who said, We swear by Allah that we only wanted good and reconciliation." Allah reproaches the believers for being divided into two groups over the hypocrites, some wanting to fight them and some not, while Allah has brought them back to disbelief for their deeds, and asks if they want to guide those whom Allah has let astray, for whoever He lets astray, no one can guide. The exegetes discussed the cause: it was said the verse came down concerning those who broke the treaty and plotted against the Muslims, and they were cast back into disbelief, and the reciters differed over the reading of the word meaning cast back. And the hypocrites are those who swore they only wanted good and reconciliation while plotting evil by night. So do not be divided over them, and fight them, for they have reverted to disbelief by their deeds, and Allah knows the hypocrites, and He is All-Knowing of their plotting, and He will requite them, and the believers should be united against them, and Allah is All-Powerful over them, and He will aid the believers, and whoever Allah lets astray, none can guide, for guidance is in the hand of Allah, and He guides whom He wills, and He knows who is sincere. And the believers were commanded to fight them when they broke the covenant, and the hypocrites said we only wanted reconciliation to deceive, and Allah exposed their plotting, and He knows what they hide, and He will judge between the believers and the hypocrites, and the believers will be victorious, for Allah is with the believers, and He aids them against their enemies, and He is All-Knowing, All-Wise, and He knows the sincere from the hypocrite, and He will requite everyone according to his deed, and no one will be wronged. And obey Allah in this matter. And He guides whom He wills.

phrases.ar: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ كَمَا كَفَرُواْ فَتَكُونُونَ سَوَآءٗۖ فَلَا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ
phrases.translation: They wish you would disbelieve as they have disbelieved, so you may all be alike. So do not take them as allies unless they emigrate in the cause of Allah. But
phrases.explanation: "They wish you would disbelieve as they have disbelieved, so you may all be alike. So do not take them as allies until they emigrate for the cause of Allah. But if they turn away, seize them and kill them wherever you find them, and do not take from them any ally or helper." Allah says the hypocrites wish the believers would disbelieve like them, so do not take them as allies until they emigrate for Allah, showing sincerity, but if they turn away, seize and kill them wherever found, and take no ally or helper from them. And the exegetes discussed the allies and said the verse forbids alliance with the hypocrites who did not emigrate, and permits it for those who emigrated, and Allah knows who is sincere, and He will requite the hypocrites.

phrases.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَخُذُوهُمۡ وَٱقۡتُلُوهُمۡ حَيۡثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمۡۖ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
phrases.translation: if they turn away, then seize them and kill them wherever you find them, and do not take any of them as allies or helpers
phrases.explanation: "But if they turn away, seize them and kill them wherever you find them, and do not take from them any ally or helper." The punishment for turning away from emigration is severe, for they have shown their enmity, and the believers are commanded to fight them, and Allah is All-Powerful over them, and He knows the wrongdoers, and He will requite them, and the believers should not ally with them. And Allah knows who turns away, and He is All-Powerful over the wrongdoers, and He will seize them, and the believers should not ally with them. And do not befriend them. And Allah is All-Seeing. And He is All-Powerful.

phrases.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٌ أَوۡ جَآءُوكُمۡ حَصِرَتۡ صُدُورُهُمۡ أَن يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ أَوۡ يُقَٰتِلُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَسَلَّطَهُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَلَقَٰتَلُوكُمۡۚ فَإِنِ ٱعۡتَزَلُوكُمۡ فَلَمۡ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ وَأَلۡقَوۡاْ إِلَيۡكُمُ
phrases.translation: except those who are allies of a people you are bound with in a treaty or those wholeheartedly opposed to fighting either you or their own people. If Allah had willed, He would have empowered them to fight you. So if they refrain from fighting
phrases.explanation: "Except those who are allies of a people you are bound with in a treaty, or those who come to you with hearts restrained from fighting you or their own people. Had Allah willed, He would have empowered you over them, but He wants to test some of you through others. And whoever is killed in the cause of Allah, their deeds will never go to waste." Allah excepts from the killing those who are allied with a people bound to the Muslims by a treaty, and those who come with restrained hearts, neither wanting to fight the Muslims nor their own people. And had Allah willed, He would have given the believers power over them, but He wants to test some through others. And whoever is killed in Allah's cause, his deeds will not go to waste, for Allah will reward him with Paradise. And the exegetes discussed the treaty and the restrained hearts, and said the exception is for those who have a valid treaty or who are neutral, and Allah knows who is sincere. And the treaty must be valid and honored, for Allah loves those who keep their covenants, and the neutral ones are spared, for they do not fight, and Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who is sincere in his treaty and who is not, and He will judge between all on the Day of Judgment. And do not break the treaty. And He is All-Knowing of the treaties. And He is All-Just.

phrases.ar: ٱلسَّلَمَ فَمَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبِيلٗا
phrases.translation: you and offer you peace, then Allah does not permit you to harm them
phrases.explanation: "Had Allah willed, He would have empowered you over them, but He wants to test some of you through others. And whoever is killed in the cause of Allah, their deeds will never go to waste." The test is part of the wisdom of Allah, and the martyr's deeds are recorded, and Allah is All-Generous, and He will not waste the deed of anyone, and He is All-Knowing of who is killed in His cause. And the martyr will be in Paradise, and Allah is All-Generous to the martyrs. And fear Allah. And He will not waste it, and the reward is great. And He is All-Generous.

phrases.ar: سَتَجِدُونَ ءَاخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَأۡمَنُوكُمۡ وَيَأۡمَنُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ كُلَّ مَا رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلۡفِتۡنَةِ أُرۡكِسُواْ فِيهَاۚ
phrases.translation: You will find others who wish to be safe from you and their own people. Yet they cannot resist the temptation ˹of disbelief or hostility˺. If they do not
phrases.explanation: "You will find others who wish to be safe from you and their own people. Every time they are tempted, they fall into it. So if they do not withdraw from you, offer you peace, or restrain their hands, seize them and kill them wherever you find them. We have made these a clear authority for you." Allah describes a people who wish to be safe from the believers and their own people, but every time they are tested, they fall into disbelief and treachery. So if they do not withdraw from fighting, offer peace, or restrain their hands, the believers are given a clear authority to seize and kill them wherever found. And the exegetes said the verse is about those who pretended Islam for safety but plotted against it, and Allah knows the hypocrites, and He will requite them, and the believers are permitted to fight them. And Allah knows their treachery, and He will expose them, and the believers should be cautious of them.

phrases.ar: فَإِن لَّمۡ يَعۡتَزِلُوكُمۡ وَيُلۡقُوٓاْ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ وَيَكُفُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فَخُذُوهُمۡ وَٱقۡتُلُوهُمۡ حَيۡثُ ثَقِفۡتُمُوهُمۡۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ جَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٗا مُّبِينٗا
phrases.translation: keep away, offer you peace, or refrain from attacking you, then seize them and kill them wherever you find them. We have given you full permission over such people
phrases.explanation: "We have made these a clear authority for you." The authority is clear proof permitting fighting them, and Allah is All-Knowing of who withdraws and who does not, and He will judge between all, and the wrongdoer will be punished. And whoever withdraws and offers peace, he is safe, and whoever does not, the authority is against him, and Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who is sincere in his peace, and He will requite the sincere and the treacherous, and He is All-Just, and He does not wrong anyone, and the believers should follow the command of Allah in this matter. And He is All-Just.

phrases.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤۡمِنٍ أَن يَقۡتُلَ مُؤۡمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَـٔٗاۚ وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤۡمِنًا خَطَـٔٗا فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖ وَدِيَةٞ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَصَّدَّقُواْۚ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوۡمٍ عَدُوّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوۡمِۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُم مِّيثَٰقٞ فَدِيَةٞ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ وَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مُّؤۡمِنَةٖۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ تَوۡبَةٗ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
phrases.translation: It is not lawful for a believer to kill another except by mistake. And whoever kills a believer unintentionally must free a believing slave and pay blood-money to the victim’s family—unless they waive it charitably. But if the victim is a believer from a hostile people, then a believing slave must be freed. And if the victim is from a people bound with you in a treaty, then blood-money must be paid to the family along with freeing a believing slave. Those who are unable, let them fast two consecutive months—as a means of repentance to Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
phrases.explanation: "It is not lawful for a believer to kill a believer, except by mistake. And whoever kills a believer by mistake must free a believing slave and pay blood money to the family, unless they pardon it. If the slain believer was from a people at war with you, then only freeing a believing slave is due. If he was from a people you have a treaty with, then blood money and freeing a slave. Whoever cannot afford that must fast two consecutive months. That is Allah's pardon, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise. And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his reward is Hell forever, and Allah's anger and curse will be upon him, and He has prepared for him a great punishment." Allah forbids a believer from killing another believer except by mistake, and legislates the expiation: freeing a believing slave and paying blood money to the family, unless they pardon. If the slain was from an enemy people, only freeing a slave is due, and if from a people with a treaty, blood money and freeing a slave, and whoever cannot afford it, fasts two consecutive months, which is a pardon from Allah. And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his reward is Hell forever, with Allah's anger and curse upon him, and a great punishment prepared. And the exegetes discussed the blood money and the fasting, and said the intentional killing is a major sin, and Allah is All-Knowing of the intention, All-Wise in His legislation.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يَقۡتُلۡ مُؤۡمِنٗا مُّتَعَمِّدٗا فَجَزَآؤُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَٰلِدٗا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ وَلَعَنَهُۥ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُۥ عَذَابًا عَظِيمٗا
phrases.translation: And whoever kills a believer intentionally, their reward will be Hell—where they will stay indefinitely. Allah will be displeased with them, condemn them, and will prepare for them a tremendous punishment
phrases.explanation: "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, their reward will be Hell, where they will abide forever, and Allah's anger and curse will be upon them, and He has prepared for them a great punishment." Allah says whoever kills a believer intentionally will abide in Hell forever, and Allah's anger and curse are upon him, and a great punishment is prepared for him. And the exegetes said the intentional killing is one of the greatest sins, and the killer will abide in the Fire, and Allah is All-Just, and He does not wrong anyone, and He knows the intention, and He will requite the intentional killer with the everlasting Fire, and the believer should fear this and avoid oppression. The exegetes differed over what makes the killing intentional: some said it is when the killer aims at the victim with a weapon that kills, others that it is every killing in which he aims at the destruction of the soul. In all views, the intentional killer is threatened with the everlasting Fire, and Allah is All-Knowing of the intention, and He is All-Just in His threat, and the believer should fear Allah and avoid killing, and if it happens, he should repent, and Allah is All-Forgiving to those who repent. And the threat is severe, and the killer should repent, and Allah accepts the repentance of those who repent before death.

phrases.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا ضَرَبۡتُمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَبَيَّنُواْ وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلسَّلَٰمَ لَسۡتَ مُؤۡمِنٗا تَبۡتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ كَثِيرَةٞۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كُنتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
phrases.translation: O believers! When you struggle in the cause of Allah, be sure of who you fight. And do not say to those who offer you ˹greetings of˺ peace, “You are no believer!”—seeking a fleeting worldly gain. Instead, Allah has infinite bounties ˹in store˺. You were initially like them then Allah blessed you ˹with Islam˺. So be sure! Indeed,
phrases.explanation: "O believers! When you struggle in the cause of Allah, be sure of who you fight, and do not say to whoever offers you the greeting of peace, You are not a believer. You seek the transient things of this worldly life, while with Allah are far better treasures. We were not like that before. Allah has done you a favor, so be sure of who you fight. Allah is All-Aware of what you do." Allah commands the believers, when they go forth in His cause, to ascertain clearly who they fight, and not to say to one who greets them with peace that he is not a believer, seeking the spoils of this world, while with Allah are better treasures, Paradise. And He reminds them that they were not like that before, and He has favored them, so they should be sure whom they fight, and Allah is All-Aware of what they do, and He will requite the one who kills a Muslim wrongly. It is said the verse was revealed concerning a man killed by a raiding party who was greeted with peace but killed for his belongings, and the reciters differed over a reading. So ascertain before fighting, and do not kill for the worldly gain, for with Allah is the better treasure, and He is All-Aware of what you do, and He will requite the wrongdoer. And be sure of who you fight, and do not be hasty. And the greeting of peace is a sign of faith, and killing the one who gives it for the worldly gain is a great wrong, and Allah is All-Aware of it, and He will requite it, and the believers should be careful, and Allah has favored them, so they should be grateful and be sure of who they fight.

phrases.ar: خَبِيرٗا
phrases.translation: Allah is All-Aware of what you do
phrases.explanation: "Allah is All-Aware of what you do." He is aware of your fighting and your intentions, and He will requite you for it. And He knows the intention of the fighter, and He will reward the sincere and punish the one who kills for the worldly gain, and the believer should fear Allah and ascertain before fighting, and Allah is All-Aware, All-Knowing. And whoever ascertains, he is safe, and whoever is hasty, he may wrong, and Allah is All-Aware of the hasty and the sure, and He will judge between them with justice, and He knows the hearts, and He does not wrong anyone, and the believer should ascertain in all his affairs, and Allah is All-Knowing of what he does.

phrases.ar: لَّا يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡقَٰعِدُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ غَيۡرُ أُوْلِي ٱلضَّرَرِ وَٱلۡمُجَٰهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡۚ فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡقَٰعِدِينَ دَرَجَةٗۚ
phrases.translation: Those who stay at home—except those with valid excuses—are not equal to those who strive in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Allah has elevated in rank those who strive with their wealth and their lives above those who stay behind ˹with
phrases.explanation: "Those who stay at home, except those with valid excuses, are not equal to those who strive with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allah. Allah has preferred the strivers over those who stay at home in far superior ranks, forgiveness, and mercy from Him. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah says those who stay at home without a valid excuse are not equal to those who strive with their wealth and lives in His cause, and He has preferred the strivers with ranks far above, forgiveness, and mercy. And the exegetes discussed the excuse and the preference, and said the valid excuse is illness or the like, and the preference is in this life and the next, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to those who are excused and to those who repent. And strive with your wealth and your lives, and do not stay home without excuse. And He knows all.

phrases.ar: وَكُلّٗا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَفَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡقَٰعِدِينَ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
phrases.translation: valid excuses˺. Allah has promised each a fine reward, but those who strive will receive a far better reward than others—
phrases.explanation: "Allah has preferred the strivers over those who stay at home in far superior ranks, forgiveness, and mercy from Him. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." The ranks are in Paradise, and the forgiveness and mercy are for the strivers and the excused, and Allah knows who strives and who is excused, and He will requite each according to his deed. And whoever strives, Allah will prefer him, and the ranks are in Paradise, and the forgiveness is for the sins, and the mercy is from Allah, and He knows the excused and the striver, and He will requite each. And He is All-Generous. And He sees the strivers.

phrases.ar: دَرَجَٰتٖ مِّنۡهُ وَمَغۡفِرَةٗ وَرَحۡمَةٗۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمًا
phrases.translation: far superior ranks, forgiveness, and mercy from Him. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.explanation: "Far superior ranks, forgiveness, and mercy from Him. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah has granted the strivers ranks far superior, with forgiveness and mercy, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to His servants, so strive in His cause and He will prefer you, and He knows who strives sincerely, and He will reward him with the highest ranks. The exegetes differed over the meaning of the ranks: some said they are the degrees of Paradise, others that they are the nearness to Allah and the reward. And in all views, the strivers are preferred, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, and He forgives the sins of the strivers, and He knows what is in the hearts, and He will reward the sincere striver with the highest ranks, and the believer should strive in the cause of Allah, and Allah will prefer him over those who stay at home.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ قَالُواْ فِيمَ كُنتُمۡۖ قَالُواْ كُنَّا مُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ قَالُوٓاْ أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ أَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٗ فَتُهَاجِرُواْ فِيهَاۚ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرًا
phrases.translation: When the angels seize the souls of those who have wronged themselves—scolding them, “What do you think you were doing?” they will reply, “We were oppressed in the land.” The angels will respond, “Was Allah’s earth not spacious enough for you to emigrate?” It is they who will have Hell as their home—what an evil destination
phrases.explanation: "When the angels seize the souls of those who have wronged themselves, scolding them, Where were you? they will reply, We were oppressed and helpless in the land. The angels will say, Was Allah's earth not spacious enough for you to emigrate? Their refuge will be Hell, what an evil destination!" Allah describes the angels taking the souls of those who died while wronging themselves by staying among the disbelievers without emigrating, scolding them and asking where they were, and they reply that they were oppressed in the land, and the angels say the earth of Allah was spacious enough for them to emigrate, and their refuge is Hell, an evil destination. And the exegetes said the verse is about those who excused themselves with oppression while they could emigrate, and Allah knows who is truly oppressed, and He will requite the wrongdoers, and the believer should emigrate if he is oppressed and cannot practice his religion.

phrases.ar: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةٗ وَلَا يَهۡتَدُونَ سَبِيلٗا
phrases.translation: Except helpless men, women, and children who cannot afford a way out—
phrases.explanation: "Except helpless men, women, and children who cannot afford a way out, nor are they guided to a path." Allah excepts from the blame the helpless men, women, and children who are oppressed and cannot find a way out nor are guided to a path, for they are excused because of their weakness. And the exegetes said the weak are those who could not emigrate because of their inability, and Allah is All-Merciful to them, and He will pardon them, and He knows their weakness, and the able are not excused. And Allah knows who is truly helpless, and He will not blame them, for He is All-Merciful, and He knows the hearts, and the believer should help the weak if he can.

phrases.ar: فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَعۡفُوَ عَنۡهُمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُورٗا
phrases.translation: it is right to hope that Allah will pardon them. For Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving
phrases.explanation: "It is right to hope that Allah will pardon them. For Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving." Allah says it may be that He will pardon the weak, for He is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving. And the exegetes said the verse was revealed concerning the weak who were excused, and Allah may pardon them, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to His servants, and He forgives whom He wills, and the believer should hope in the mercy of Allah and do good. And the pardon is for their weakness, and Allah is All-Knowing of who is excused, and He is All-Merciful to the weak, and He forgives their inability to emigrate, and the believer should hope in the pardon of Allah and do good, and Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving to all His servants.

phrases.ar: ۞ وَمَن يُهَاجِرۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يَجِدۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُرَٰغَمٗا كَثِيرٗا وَسَعَةٗۚ وَمَن يَخۡرُجۡ مِنۢ بَيۡتِهِۦ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ يُدۡرِكۡهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَقَدۡ وَقَعَ أَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
phrases.translation: Whoever emigrates in the cause of Allah will find many safe havens and bountiful resources throughout the earth. Those who leave their homes and die while emigrating to Allah and His Messenger—their reward has already been secured with Allah. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.explanation: "Whoever emigrates in the cause of Allah will find many safe havens and bountiful provision in the land. And whoever leaves their home emigrating to Allah and His Messenger, and then death overtakes them, their reward is with Allah. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah promises whoever emigrates in His cause that he will find in the land many safe havens and bountiful provision, and whoever leaves his home emigrating to Allah and His Messenger and death overtakes him, his reward is with Allah, as if he completed the emigration. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, so He rewards the emigrant and the one who dies on the way, and the exegetes discussed the bounty and the reward, and said the emigration is for the sake of Allah, and Allah knows the sincere, and He will reward him with Paradise. And the safe havens are the places where the believer is safe in his religion, and the bounty is the provision and the rizq, and Allah gives abundant provision to the emigrant, and the one who dies on the way of emigration has the reward of the emigrant, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, and He knows the intention of the emigrant, and He will reward him, and the exegetes said the emigration is from the land of disbelief to the land of Islam, and whoever cannot emigrate is excused if truly oppressed, and Allah knows the oppressed.

phrases.ar: وَإِذَا ضَرَبۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقۡصُرُواْ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ أَن يَفۡتِنَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ
phrases.translation: When you travel through the land, it is permissible for you to shorten the prayer—˹especially˺ if you fear an
phrases.explanation: "When you travel through the land, it is permissible for you to shorten the prayer, if you fear that the disbelievers may attack you. They are indeed a clear enemy to you." Allah permits the travelers to shorten the prayer from four to two rakahs when they fear an attack from the disbelievers, for they are a clear enemy. And the exegetes discussed the shortening and the fear, and said it is a concession from Allah for the traveler in fear, and Allah knows the fearful, and He is All-Merciful, and He permitted the shortening out of mercy to His servants. And the shortening is from four to two rakahs, and the exegetes differed over whether it applies to all prayers or the midday, afternoon, and night prayers, but the meaning is a concession in fear, and Allah is All-Merciful to the traveler, and He knows the fear, and He permitted it out of ease, and the believer should shorten when he fears and be safe, and Allah is All-Knowing of the situations.

phrases.ar: كَفَرُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ كَانُواْ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٗا مُّبِينٗا
phrases.translation: attack by the disbelievers. Indeed, the disbelievers are your sworn enemies
phrases.explanation: "They are indeed a clear enemy to you." The disbelievers are a clear, open enemy to the believers, so beware of them when you travel, and take your precautions, and Allah is All-Knowing of them and of you. And take your weapons and be cautious, and Allah is with the believers, and He will protect them, and He is All-Powerful over the disbelievers, and He knows their plotting, and He will defeat them, and the believer should fear Allah and beware of the enemy. And He will aid you. And do not fear them more than Allah, and Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who fears Him truly, and He will protect the believers.

phrases.ar: وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمۡ فَأَقَمۡتَ لَهُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَلۡتَقُمۡ طَآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُم مَّعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَهُمۡۖ فَإِذَا سَجَدُواْ فَلۡيَكُونُواْ مِن وَرَآئِكُمۡ وَلۡتَأۡتِ طَآئِفَةٌ أُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ يُصَلُّواْ فَلۡيُصَلُّواْ مَعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُواْ حِذۡرَهُمۡ وَأَسۡلِحَتَهُمۡۗ وَدَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ تَغۡفُلُونَ عَنۡ أَسۡلِحَتِكُمۡ وَأَمۡتِعَتِكُمۡ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيۡكُم مَّيۡلَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۚ
phrases.translation: When you ˹O Prophet˺ are ˹campaigning˺ with them and you lead them in prayer, let one group of them pray with you—while armed. When they prostrate themselves, let the other group stand guard behind them. Then the group that has not yet prayed will then join you in prayer—and let them be vigilant and armed. The disbelievers would wish to see you neglect your weapons and
phrases.explanation: "When you are campaigning with them and you lead them in prayer, let a group of them stand with you, taking their arms. When they prostrate, let them move behind you, and let another group, which has not prayed, come and pray with you, taking their precautions. When you finish the prayer, remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on your sides. Once you are safe, establish the prayer. Prayer is indeed a timed obligation for the believers." Allah describes the prayer of fear in battle: when the Prophet leads them in prayer, a group stands with him taking their arms, and when they prostrate, they move behind, and another group that has not prayed comes and prays with him, taking precautions. And when the prayer is finished, remember Allah in all states, and when safe, establish the regular prayer, for prayer is a timed obligation for the believers. And the exegetes discussed the manner of the prayer of fear and the groups, and said it is a concession for the believers in battle, and Allah knows their situation, and He made it easy, and He is All-Knowing, All-Wise. And the prayer of fear is done in congregation with precautions, and the exegetes described its manner in detail, and said the group that prays first prostrates and moves behind, and the second group prays, and all take their arms, and Allah is All-Knowing of the battle, and He made the prayer easy in fear, and the believer should establish it even in battle.

phrases.ar: وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِن كَانَ بِكُمۡ أَذٗى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوۡ كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَكُمۡۖ وَخُذُواْ حِذۡرَكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
phrases.translation: belongings, so they could launch a sweeping assault on you. But there is no blame if you lay aside your weapons when overcome by heavy rain or illness—but take precaution. Indeed, Allah has prepared a humiliating punishment for the disbelievers
phrases.explanation: "Once you are safe, establish the prayer. Prayer is indeed a timed obligation for the believers." After the fear is gone, establish the prayer at its times, for it is obligatory at its fixed times, and it is a trust, and Allah is All-Knowing of who establishes it and who neglects it, and He will requite the negligent, and the believer should not neglect the prayer even in battle, and Allah has made it easy in fear. And do not neglect it, for it is the pillar of the religion, and Allah is All-Aware of what you do, and He will requite the one who establishes it and the one who neglects it.

phrases.ar: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمٗا وَقُعُودٗا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمۡۚ فَإِذَا ٱطۡمَأۡنَنتُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۚ
phrases.translation: When the prayers are over, remember Allah—whether you are standing, sitting, or lying down. But when you are
phrases.explanation: "When the prayers are over, remember Allah whether you are standing, sitting, or lying on your sides. Once you are safe, establish the prayer. Prayer is indeed a timed obligation for the believers." Allah commands remembering Him in all states after the prayer of fear, standing, sitting, and lying down, and when safe, establishing the regular prayer at its times, for prayer is a timed obligation. And the exegetes discussed the remembrance and said it is the dhikr in all states, and the believer should not neglect it, and Allah is All-Knowing of what he remembers, and He will reward the one who remembers much. And the remembrance of Allah in all states is a protection for the believer, and he should remember Him much, and Allah loves those who remember Him much.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ كَانَتۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ كِتَٰبٗا مَّوۡقُوتٗا
phrases.translation: secure, establish regular prayers. Indeed, performing prayers is a duty on the believers at the appointed times
phrases.explanation: "Once you are safe, establish the prayer. Prayer is indeed a timed obligation for the believers." After safety, establish the prayer at its fixed times, for it is a trust between the servant and his Lord, and Allah is All-Knowing of who establishes it and who neglects it, and He will requite the negligent, and the prayer is the pillar of the religion. And the times of the prayer are fixed in the Book, and the believer should observe them, and Allah is All-Knowing of his observance, and He will reward the one who establishes the prayer at its times, and He is All-Forgiving to the one who errs and repents, and the prayer is the light of the believer and the proof of his faith, and Allah is All-Aware of what he does. And He is All-Forgiving.

phrases.ar: وَلَا تَهِنُواْ فِي ٱبۡتِغَآءِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِۖ إِن تَكُونُواْ تَأۡلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَأۡلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأۡلَمُونَۖ وَتَرۡجُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَرۡجُونَۗ
phrases.translation: Do not falter in pursuit of the enemy—if you are suffering, they too are suffering. But you can hope to receive from Allah what they can never hope
phrases.explanation: "Do not falter in pursuit of the enemy. If you are suffering, they too are suffering. But you hope from Allah what they do not hope, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise." Allah forbids faltering in pursuit of the enemy, for if the believers suffer, the disbelievers suffer too, but the believers hope from Allah Paradise and reward, which the disbelievers do not hope, and Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, All-Wise in His legislation. And the exegetes said the verse encourages the believers to be patient in battle, for the enemy suffers too, and the believer has the hope of the Hereafter, and Allah will aid the patient, and He knows who hopes and who despairs. And do not give up.

phrases.ar: وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
phrases.translation: for. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
phrases.explanation: "Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise." He knows the suffering of both sides and the hope of the believers, and He is All-Wise in promising reward, and He will requite the patient believer. And the believers hope in the mercy of Allah and His Paradise, and the disbelievers have no hope, and Allah is All-Knowing of who hopes, and He will reward the hopeful believer with the best of reward, and He is All-Wise in His promise, and He does not break His promise. And He knows the patient. And the hope of the believers is in Allah alone, and whoever hopes in Allah, He will not disappoint him, and Allah is All-Generous, and He gives the believers the victory and the reward, and He knows the enemy and the friend.

phrases.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِتَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَا تَكُن لِّلۡخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمٗا
phrases.translation: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth to judge between people by means of what Allah has shown you. So do not be an advocate for the deceitful
phrases.explanation: "Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you in truth to judge between people by what Allah has shown you. So do not be an advocate for the treacherous." Allah says He sent the Book to the Prophet in truth to judge between people by what He has shown him of the revelation, so he should not be an advocate for those who betray the trust, for Allah does not love the traitors. And the exegetes discussed the treachery and said it is the betrayal of the trust in judgment, and the Prophet judges by the apparent and Allah knows the hidden, and He will requite the treacherous. And judge by the truth.

phrases.ar: وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرِ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
phrases.translation: And seek Allah’s forgiveness—indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.explanation: "And seek Allah's forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah commands the Prophet to seek forgiveness, and to ask Allah to remit the punishment from him if it befalls, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful. And the exegetes said the seeking of forgiveness is for the sins, and Allah accepts the repentance of His servants, and He forgives whom He wills, and He knows the sincere, and the believer should seek forgiveness too, and Allah is All-Forgiving to all who repent. And the exegetes said the forgiveness sought is for the sins of the servants and the mistakes in judgment, and Allah forgives the apparent and the hidden, and He knows the sincere repentant, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, and He rejoices at the repentance of His servant, and the believer should seek forgiveness often, and Allah accepts the repentance, and He is All-Knowing, All-Wise. And He is All-Knowing.

phrases.ar: وَلَا تُجَٰدِلۡ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡتَانُونَ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ خَوَّانًا أَثِيمٗا
phrases.translation: Do not advocate for those who wrong themselves. Surely Allah does not like those who are deceitful, sinful
phrases.explanation: "Do not advocate for those who wrong themselves. Surely Allah does not like those who are treacherous. They try to hide their deception from people, but they can never hide it from Allah. He is with them when they plot by night, for Allah encompasses what they do." Allah forbids advocating for those who wrong themselves by treachery, for He does not like the traitors. And He says they hide their deception from people but cannot hide it from Allah, and He is with them when they plot by night, encompassing their deeds. And the exegetes said the verse is general for whoever betrays the trust, and the Prophet should judge by the apparent, and Allah knows the hidden plots, and He will requite the plotters, and the believer should not betray the trust. And judge by the apparent, and leave the hidden to Allah, and do not betray the trust, and Allah knows the treacherous, and He will requite them, and the believer should be trustworthy, and Allah loves the trustworthy. And He encompasses all things. And He is All-Hearing of the plot.

phrases.ar: يَسۡتَخۡفُونَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يَسۡتَخۡفُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُمۡ إِذۡ يُبَيِّتُونَ مَا لَا يَرۡضَىٰ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ مُحِيطًا
phrases.translation: They try to hide ˹their deception˺ from people, but they can never hide it from Allah—in Whose presence they plot by night what is displeasing to Him. And Allah is Fully Aware of what they do
phrases.explanation: "Behold, you pleaded for them in this worldly life, but who will plead with Allah for them on the Day of Resurrection? Or who will be their protector? Have you forgotten that Allah knows what they hide, and that He encompasses their deeds, and they cannot hide anything from Him?" Allah addresses those who pleaded for the treacherous in this world: who will plead for them on the Day of Resurrection, or who will be their protector. And He reminds that He knows what they hide, and they cannot hide from Him. And the exegetes said the pleading in this world does not avail on the Day of Resurrection, for Allah judges with justice, and He knows the hidden, and the treacherous will have no helper, and Allah encompasses all.

phrases.ar: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ جَٰدَلۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فَمَن يُجَٰدِلُ ٱللَّهَ عَنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَم مَّن يَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَكِيلٗا
phrases.translation: Here you are! You ˹believers˺ are advocating for them in this life, but who will ˹dare to˺ advocate for them before Allah on the Day of Judgment? Or who will come to their defence
phrases.explanation: "Here you are! You believers are advocating for them in this life, but who will advocate for them with Allah on the Day of Resurrection, or who will be their protector?" Allah addresses those who pleaded for the treacherous in this worldly life: who will plead for them with Allah on the Day of Resurrection, or who will protect them from the punishment. And the exegetes said the pleading in this world does not avail on the Day of Judgment, for Allah judges with justice, and the treacherous will have no helper, and Allah knows what they hide, and He will requite them, and the believer should not plead for the wrongdoer. And Allah knows the hidden.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ سُوٓءًا أَوۡ يَظۡلِمۡ نَفۡسَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَسۡتَغۡفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
phrases.translation: Whoever commits evil or wrongs themselves then seeks Allah’s forgiveness will certainly find Allah All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.explanation: "Whoever commits evil or wrongs themselves then seeks Allah's forgiveness will certainly find Allah All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah says whoever does evil or wrongs himself, then seeks forgiveness, will find Allah All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, for He accepts the repentance of His servants and forgives their sins. And the exegetes said the verse encourages repentance, for whoever repents sincerely, Allah forgives, and He knows the sincere from the insincere, and He is All-Knowing, All-Wise, and the believer should hasten to repentance before death. And whoever repents before death, Allah accepts, and He is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who is sincere, and He will reward the sincere repentant with Paradise.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يَكۡسِبۡ إِثۡمٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَكۡسِبُهُۥ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
phrases.translation: And whoever commits a sin—it is only to their own loss. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
phrases.explanation: "And whoever commits a sin, it is only to their own loss. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise." Allah says whoever commits a sin, it is recorded against him only, and it is his loss, for Allah is All-Knowing of the deeds, All-Wise in requiting the sinner with the sin and the good doer with the reward. And the exegetes said the sin harms only the sinner, and he will be requited for it, and the believer should avoid sin and do good, and Allah knows all, and He will judge between all. And He will requite him for it. And the sin is recorded in the Book, and the sinner will be asked about it on the Day of Judgment, and no soul bears the burden of another, and Allah is All-Just, and He does not wrong anyone, and the believer should avoid sin and seek forgiveness, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to those who repent and do good.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يَكۡسِبۡ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوۡ إِثۡمٗا ثُمَّ يَرۡمِ بِهِۦ بَرِيٓـٔٗا فَقَدِ ٱحۡتَمَلَ بُهۡتَٰنٗا وَإِثۡمٗا مُّبِينٗا
phrases.translation: And whoever commits an evil or sinful deed then blames it on an innocent person, they will definitely bear the guilt of slander and blatant sin
phrases.explanation: "And whoever commits an evil or sinful deed then blames it on an innocent person has indeed taken a great sin and a clear falsehood." Allah says whoever does an evil deed and then blames an innocent person for it has burdened himself with the sin of the deed and the sin of the false accusation, which is a great wrong. And the exegetes said the verse is about bearing false witness, and the accuser will be requited for both sins, and Allah is All-Knowing of who is innocent, and He will clear him and punish the accuser, and the believer should not accuse anyone falsely. And Allah knows all.

phrases.ar: وَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكَ وَرَحۡمَتُهُۥ لَهَمَّت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُضِلُّوكَ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمۡۖ وَمَا يَضُرُّونَكَ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ وَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ مَا لَمۡ تَكُن تَعۡلَمُۚ وَكَانَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكَ عَظِيمٗا
phrases.translation: Had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy, a group of them would have sought to deceive you ˹O Prophet˺. Yet they would deceive none but themselves, nor can they harm you in the least. Allah has revealed to you the Book and wisdom and taught you what you never knew. Great ˹indeed˺ is Allah’s favour upon you
phrases.explanation: "Had it not been for Allah's grace and mercy upon you, a group of them would have sought to mislead you. But they mislead only themselves, and they do not harm you at all. Allah has sent down the Book to you and taught you what you did not know, and Allah's grace upon you is great." Allah says that had it not been for His grace and mercy upon the Prophet, a group of the hypocrites would have sought to mislead him, but they mislead only themselves, and they cannot harm him. And Allah sent down the Book and taught him what he did not know, the legislation and the knowledge, and His grace upon him is great. And the exegetes said the grace is the Islam and the revelation, and the mercy is the protection from misguidance, and Allah knows the plotters, and He will requite them, and the believer should be grateful for the grace of Allah.

phrases.ar: ۞ لَّا خَيۡرَ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّن نَّجۡوَىٰهُمۡ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَمَرَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَوۡ مَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ إِصۡلَٰحِۭ بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ ٱبۡتِغَآءَ مَرۡضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ فَسَوۡفَ نُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
phrases.translation: There is no good in most of their secret talks—except those encouraging charity, kindness, or reconciliation between people. And whoever does this seeking Allah’s pleasure, We will grant them a great reward
phrases.explanation: "There is no good in much of their secret talks, except those encouraging charity, kindness, or reconciliation. And whoever does this seeking Allah's pleasure, We will grant them a great reward." Allah says there is no good in much of the secret talks of the hypocrites, except the one who enjoins charity, kindness, or reconciliation between people, and whoever does that seeking the pleasure of Allah will be granted a great reward. And the exegetes discussed the secret talks and said they are the plotting, and the good in them is the enjoining of good, and Allah loves the doers of good, and He will reward them greatly, and the believer should enjoin good in secret and in public, and Allah knows his intention.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعۡ غَيۡرَ سَبِيلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِۦ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ وَنُصۡلِهِۦ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرًا
phrases.translation: And whoever defies the Messenger after guidance has become clear to them and follows a path other than that of the believers, We will let them pursue what they have chosen, then burn them in Hell—what an evil end
phrases.explanation: "And whoever defies the Messenger after guidance has become clear to them and follows not the path of the believers, We will turn them in the direction they have turned, and We will burn them in Hell, what an evil destination!" Allah says whoever disobeys the Messenger after the guidance has become clear and follows a path other than the believers will be turned in the direction he chose, away from the truth, and burned in Hell, an evil destination. And the exegetes said the verse is about those who apostatize and follow the disbelievers, and Allah lets them go astray in their deviation, and He will punish them in the Fire, and Allah knows the wrongdoers, and He is All-Just, and the believer should hold fast to the path of the believers.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَغۡفِرُ أَن يُشۡرَكَ بِهِۦ وَيَغۡفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلَۢا بَعِيدًا
phrases.translation: Surely Allah does not forgive associating ˹others˺ with Him ˹in worship˺, but forgives anything else of whoever He wills. Indeed, whoever associates ˹others˺ with Allah has clearly gone far astray
phrases.explanation: "Surely Allah does not forgive associating others with Him in worship, but forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And whoever associates others with Allah has indeed gone far astray." Allah says He does not forgive shirk, but forgives the lesser sins for whom He wills, and whoever commits shirk has gone far astray. And the exegetes discussed the verse and said the shirk is the greatest sin, and whoever dies upon it will not be forgiven, and Allah is All-Just, and He has made the warning clear, and the believer should avoid shirk and repent from the lesser sins. And whoever repents from shirk, Allah may forgive him.

phrases.ar: إِن يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ إِنَٰثٗا وَإِن يَدۡعُونَ إِلَّا شَيۡطَٰنٗا مَّرِيدٗا
phrases.translation: Instead of Allah, they only invoke female gods and they ˹actually˺ invoke none but a rebellious Satan—
phrases.explanation: "Instead of Allah, they only invoke female gods, and they actually invoke none but a rebellious devil." Allah says the disbelievers, instead of Allah, invoke only female idols, names they gave to their idols, and they invoke nothing but a rebellious devil, Satan, who misleads them. And the exegetes differed over the female gods, some naming them, and said they are idols that have no power, and the believer should worship Allah alone, and Allah is All-Knowing of the polytheists, and He will requite them. And the female names are from the naming of the polytheists, and they have no partner with Allah, and Allah is All-Powerful, and the idols cannot harm or benefit, and the believer should fear Allah and worship Him alone, and He will reward the monotheist.

phrases.ar: لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُۘ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنۡ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبٗا مَّفۡرُوضٗا
phrases.translation: cursed by Allah—who said, “I will surely take hold of a certain number of Your servants
phrases.explanation: "Cursed by Allah, who said, I will surely take of Your servants a certain number." Allah says Satan was cursed, and he said he would take a portion of the servants of Allah, leading them astray. And the exegetes said the portion is those who follow him, and Allah knows them, and He will requite them, and the believer should seek refuge in Allah from Satan, and Allah is All-Hearing of the supplication, and He answers the supplicant. And the cursed Satan is the accursed one whom Allah has driven away, and his portion is the misguided, and the believer should say the seeking of refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan, and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing of who seeks refuge, and He will protect the one who seeks refuge.

phrases.ar: وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمۡ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمۡ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلۡقَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ وَلِيّٗا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ خَسِرَ خُسۡرَانٗا مُّبِينٗا
phrases.translation: I will certainly mislead them and delude them with empty hopes. Also, I will order them and they will slit the ears of cattle and alter Allah’s creation.” And whoever takes Satan as a guardian instead of Allah has certainly suffered a tremendous loss
phrases.explanation: "I will certainly mislead them and delude them with empty hopes. Also, I will command them to slit the ears of cattle, to change Allah's creation, and to take Satan as a lord instead of Allah. Whoever does so has certainly lost a clear loss." Allah quotes Satan saying he will mislead the servants of Allah and fill them with false hopes, command them to mutilate cattle and change the creation of Allah, and take him as a lord besides Allah, and whoever follows him loses clearly. And the exegetes discussed the commands of Satan and said they are the whisperings that lead to sin, and the believer should seek refuge in Allah from Satan and not obey him, and Allah is All-Knowing of who follows Satan, and He will requite them.

phrases.ar: يَعِدُهُمۡ وَيُمَنِّيهِمۡۖ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
phrases.translation: Satan only makes them ˹false˺ promises and deludes them with ˹empty˺ hopes. Truly Satan promises them nothing but delusion
phrases.explanation: "Satan only makes them false promises and deludes them with empty hopes. Truly, Satan's promises are nothing but delusion." Allah says Satan promises his followers nothing but delusion, for his promises are false, and they will find no truth in them on the Day of Resurrection. And the exegetes said the promise of Satan is called delusion because it is false, and the believer should not trust the promises of Satan, and he should trust the promise of Allah, which is true, and Allah does not break His promise, and He will reward the believers. And the promise of Allah is truth, and the believer should hold fast to it.

phrases.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَأۡوَىٰهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ عَنۡهَا مَحِيصٗا
phrases.translation: It is they who will have Hell as their home, and they will find no escape from it
phrases.explanation: "It is they who will have Hell as their home, and they will find no escape from it." Allah says those who follow Satan and take him as a lord instead of Allah will have Hell as their abode, and they will find no escape or helper from it, for the Fire is their everlasting home. And the exegetes said the verse completes the description of the followers of Satan, and Allah is All-Just, and He will requite them with the Fire, and the believer should seek refuge in Allah from Satan and not follow him. And no one can avert it. And He is severe in punishment.

phrases.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَمَنۡ أَصۡدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ قِيلٗا
phrases.translation: And those who believe and do good, We will soon admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah’s promise is ˹always˺ true. And whose word is more truthful than Allah’s
phrases.explanation: "And those who believe and do righteous deeds, We shall admit them into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. That is the great triumph." Allah promises the believers who do good deeds that He will admit them into Gardens with flowing rivers, to abide forever, and that is the great triumph, for no success is greater than Paradise. And the exegetes said the verse is general for every believer who does good, and Allah is All-Knowing of who believes and does good, and He will reward them with the gardens of bliss, and He is All-Generous, and He does not wrong anyone. And Allah is All-Generous.

phrases.ar: لَّيۡسَ بِأَمَانِيِّكُمۡ وَلَآ أَمَانِيِّ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِۗ مَن يَعۡمَلۡ سُوٓءٗا يُجۡزَ بِهِۦ وَلَا يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٗا
phrases.translation: ˹Divine grace is˺ neither by your wishes nor those of the People of the Book! Whoever commits evil will be rewarded accordingly, and they will find no
phrases.explanation: "Divine grace is neither by your wishes nor those of the People of the Book. Whoever does evil will be requited for it and will find no protector or helper besides Allah." Allah says the grace is not by the wishes of the Muslims nor the wishes of the People of the Book, for the grace is from Allah and He gives it to whom He wills. And whoever does evil will be requited for it and will find no protector or helper besides Allah. And the exegetes discussed the wishes and said they are the false hopes, and the requiting of evil is certain, and Allah is All-Just, and He knows the doers of evil, and He will requite them, and the believer should do good and hope in the grace of Allah. The exegetes differed over the wishes: some said both the Muslims and the People of the Book are meant, others that the People of the Book specifically are meant, and others that the wishes are the false hopes of both groups that the grace is theirs by their lineage or their book. In all views, the grace is from Allah alone, and He gives it to whom He wills, and the doers of evil will be requited, and they will find no protector besides Allah, and Allah knows the wrongdoers, and He is All-Just, and He will judge between all with justice on the Day of Judgment, and the believer should do good and not rely on his wishes but on the grace of Allah, and seek His forgiveness.

phrases.ar: وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
phrases.translation: protector or helper besides Allah
phrases.explanation: "Whoever does evil will be requited for it and will find no protector or helper besides Allah." The requital is certain, and none besides Allah can protect, so do good and fear Allah. And the protector is Allah alone, and whoever has Allah, he has everything, and whoever misses Allah, he has missed everything, and Allah is All-Powerful over His servants, and He knows who does evil, and He will requite him, and the believer should fear Him and do good. And do good. And whoever does evil, let him repent, and Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to those who return to Him before death, and He knows the hearts, and He accepts the sincere repentance.

phrases.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوۡ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
phrases.translation: But those who do good—whether male or female—and have faith will enter Paradise and will never be wronged ˹even as much as˺ the
phrases.explanation: "But those who do good deeds, whether male or female, and have faith, will enter Paradise and will not be wronged even by a speck on a date pit." Allah says whoever does good deeds, male or female, and is a believer, will enter Paradise, and will not be wronged even by the weight of a speck on a date pit. And the exegetes discussed the deed and said it is the good deed with faith, and the wrong of a speck is the smallest wrong, and Allah is All-Just, and He does not wrong anyone, and He will reward the believer for his good deeds. And He multiplies the reward.

phrases.ar: نَقِيرٗا
phrases.translation: speck on a date stone
phrases.explanation: "Will not be wronged even by a speck on a date pit." Allah does not wrong anyone even the smallest amount, and He multiplies the reward. And whoever does good with faith, Allah will not wrong him, and He is All-Generous, and He rewards the good deed with tenfold and more, and the believer should do good whether male or female, for all are equal before Allah in reward, and He knows the doers of good, and He will reward them with Paradise. And He is All-Knowing. And whoever does good, Allah will not wrong him in the least, and He will admit him into Paradise with the righteous, and He is All-Generous, and He does not wrong anyone.

phrases.ar: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ دِينٗا مِّمَّنۡ أَسۡلَمَ وَجۡهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ وَٱتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۗ وَٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ خَلِيلٗا
phrases.translation: And who is better in faith than those who ˹fully˺ submit themselves to Allah, do good, and follow the Way of Abraham, the upright? Allah chose Abraham as a close friend
phrases.explanation: "And who is better in faith than those who fully submit themselves to Allah, and do good, and follow the creed of Abraham, the upright? Allah took Abraham as a close friend." Allah asks who is better in religion than the one who submits fully to Allah, does good, and follows the creed of Abraham, the hanif, the upright, for Allah took Abraham as a close friend. And the exegetes said the submission is Islam, and the creed of Abraham is the pure monotheism, and Allah chose him as a friend, and the believer should follow the creed of Abraham, and Allah knows the best in religion, and He will reward the best.

phrases.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مُّحِيطٗا
phrases.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And Allah is Fully Aware of everything
phrases.explanation: "To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And Allah encompasses the disbelievers." Allah says to Him alone belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth, for He is the Creator and the Owner, and He encompasses the disbelievers, knowing their deeds and their plots. And the exegetes said the encompassing is the knowledge and the power, and Allah knows what the disbelievers hide, and He is All-Powerful over them, and He will requite them, and the believer should fear Allah, for all belongs to Him and He knows all. And He is All-Powerful. And He is All-Knowing.

phrases.ar: وَيَسۡتَفۡتُونَكَ فِي ٱلنِّسَآءِۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفۡتِيكُمۡ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ فِي يَتَٰمَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِي لَا تُؤۡتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرۡغَبُونَ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَضۡعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنِ وَأَن تَقُومُواْ لِلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۚ وَمَا تَفۡعَلُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ
phrases.translation: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding women. Say, “It is Allah Who instructs you regarding them. Instruction has ˹already˺ been revealed in the Book concerning the orphan women you deprive of their due rights but still wish to marry, also helpless children, as well as standing up for orphans’ rights. And
phrases.explanation: "They ask you regarding women. Say, Allah instructs you about them, and what is recited to you in the Book concerning the orphan girls to whom you do not give what is prescribed for them, though you desire to marry them, and concerning the helpless among children. And Allah commands you to stand firm in justice for the orphans. Whatever good you do, Allah is All-Knowing." Allah answers those who asked the Prophet about women: He instructs them about the orphan girls, to give them their rights and not to marry them while withholding their due, and about the weak children, and He commands standing firm in justice for the orphans. And whatever good they do, Allah knows it and will reward it. And the exegetes discussed the question and the Book, and said the verse includes the legislation on women, the orphans, and justice, and Allah knows all, and He will requite the just and the unjust. And the question was about the women of the Muslims and the orphan girls, and the answer came in the Book with the shares and the rulings, and the standing firm in justice for the orphans is a trust, and whoever wrongs an orphan, Allah will take him to account, for He is All-Knowing, All-Seeing, and He does not wrong anyone. And He is All-Knowing of the orphans.

phrases.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٗا
phrases.translation: whatever good you do is certainly well known to Allah.”
phrases.explanation: "Whatever good you do, Allah is All-Knowing." He knows the good deed and the intention, and He will reward the doer of good, and the believer should do good and stand firm in justice, and Allah sees it. And He sees the good and the evil, and He will reward the good doer with Paradise, and the wrongdoer with the Fire, and the believer should do good in secret and in public, and stand firm in justice for the weak, and Allah is All-Knowing of what he does, and He will requite him, and nothing is hidden from Him, and He is All-Just, and He does not wrong anyone in an atom's weight.

phrases.ar: وَإِنِ ٱمۡرَأَةٌ خَافَتۡ مِنۢ بَعۡلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوۡ إِعۡرَاضٗا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡهِمَآ أَن يُصۡلِحَا بَيۡنَهُمَا صُلۡحٗاۚ وَٱلصُّلۡحُ خَيۡرٞۗ وَأُحۡضِرَتِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ ٱلشُّحَّۚ وَإِن تُحۡسِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ
phrases.translation: If a woman fears indifference or neglect from her husband, there is no blame on either of them if they seek ˹fair˺ settlement, which is best. Humans are ever inclined to selfishness. But if you are gracious and mindful
phrases.explanation: "If a woman fears indifference or neglect from her husband, there is no blame on them if they seek reconciliation. Reconciliation is better. And people are prone to selfishness. But if you do good and fear Allah, Allah is All-Aware of what you do." Allah says if a woman fears nushuz or aversion from her husband, there is no sin on them if they make a settlement of reconciliation, and reconciliation is better than divorce. And souls are prone to selfishness and miserliness, but if you do good and fear Allah in the treatment of the wives, Allah is All-Aware of what you do, and He will requite the kind and the unjust. And the exegetes discussed the settlement and said it is the khul or the giving up of some rights for peace, and Allah knows the hearts. And the woman may give up part of her dowry or rights to her husband for peace, and that is permissible, and the exegetes differed over whether the settlement is the khul by which she gives him something, but the meaning is that reconciliation with some giving up of rights is lawful and better than separation. And the souls are prone to selfishness, so the spouses should fear Allah and treat each other with kindness, and not let selfishness lead to injustice, and Allah is All-Aware of what they do, in secret and in public, and He will requite the kind and the unjust.

phrases.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
phrases.translation: ˹of Allah˺, surely Allah is All-Aware of what you do
phrases.explanation: "Reconciliation is better. And if you do good and fear Allah, Allah is All-Aware of what you do." Reconciliation is better for the spouses, and fearing Allah in the treatment is the best of conduct, and Allah is All-Aware, seeing the hidden and the open.
