And whoever reconciles, Allah will reward him, and reconciliation is the best of affairs, and the believer should seek it, and Allah is All-Aware of the hearts, and He knows who desires reconciliation sincerely, and He will unite them, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful. And He knows all. And whoever fears Allah in this matter is safe, and Allah is All-Seeing of the dealings of the spouses, and He will judge between them with justice.

phrases.ar: وَلَن تَسۡتَطِيعُوٓاْ أَن تَعۡدِلُواْ بَيۡنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتُمۡۖ فَلَا تَمِيلُواْ كُلَّ ٱلۡمَيۡلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلۡمُعَلَّقَةِۚ
phrases.translation: You will never be able to maintain ˹emotional˺ justice between your wives—no matter how keen you are. So do not totally incline towards one leaving the other in suspense. And if
phrases.explanation: "You will never be able to maintain emotional justice between your wives, no matter how keen you are. So do not incline completely to one so as to leave the other in suspense. But if you do justice and fear Allah, Allah is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Allah says the believers will never be able to be perfectly just between the wives in love and inclination, even if they try, for the heart inclines, so do not incline completely to one and leave the other suspended. But if you do justice in what you can, and fear Allah, He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful. And the exegetes discussed the justice meant, some saying it is the provision and the night, others that it is what is in the hand of the husband, and the love is in the hand of Allah, and He knows the hearts.

phrases.ar: وَإِن تُصۡلِحُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
phrases.translation: you do what is right and are mindful ˹of Allah˺, surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
phrases.explanation: "But if you do justice and fear Allah, Allah is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Merciful." Justice in provision and treatment is required, and forgiveness covers the inclination of the heart, which the husband cannot control, and Allah knows that, and He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful to those who do their best. And the inclination of the heart is not in the hand of the husband, but the justice in provision and dwelling is, and whoever does that, Allah forgives the rest, for He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful, and He knows the weakness of His servants, and He does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. And He knows the hearts.

phrases.ar: وَإِن يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغۡنِ ٱللَّهُ كُلّٗا مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعًا حَكِيمٗا
phrases.translation: But if they choose to separate, Allah will enrich both of them from His bounties. And Allah is Ever-Bountiful, All-Wise
phrases.explanation: "But if they choose to separate, Allah will enrich both of them from His bounty. And Allah is All-Bountiful, All-Wise." Allah says if the spouses separate in divorce, He will enrich each of them from His bounty, for He is All-Bountiful, All-Wise, and He gives abundant provision to whom He wills. And the exegetes differed over the enrichment, some saying it is the provision and the contentment, others that it is the reward in the Hereafter for the one who is wronged, but all agree that Allah compensates both, and the believer should accept the decree of Allah with contentment. And He is All-Wise. And He knows all.

phrases.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَلَقَدۡ وَصَّيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ وَإِيَّاكُمۡ أَنِ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ وَإِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَنِيًّا حَمِيدٗا
phrases.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Indeed, We have commanded those given the Scripture before you, as well as you, to be mindful of Allah. But if you disobey, then ˹know that˺ to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy
phrases.explanation: "To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And We have instructed those who were given the Book before you, as well as you, to fear Allah. But if they disbelieve, then to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy." Allah says to Him belongs all in the heavens and the earth, and He instructed the People of the Book before and the Muslims to fear Him, and if they disbelieve, it does not harm Him, for all belongs to Him, and He is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy. And the exegetes said the instruction to fear Allah is the core of the religion for all the communities, and Allah knows who fears Him and who disbelieves, and He will requite them, and the believer should fear Allah and be grateful that He is Self-Sufficient and needs nothing from His servants.

phrases.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
phrases.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And Allah is sufficient as a Trustee of Affairs
phrases.explanation: "To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy." Allah repeats that all belongs to Him, the heavens and the earth, and He is Self-Sufficient, needing nothing, Praiseworthy in His attributes. And the exegetes said the repetition emphasizes the self-sufficiency of Allah, and the believer should rely on Him alone, for He is Self-Sufficient and He will suffice the believer, and He is All-Knowing of who relies on Him, and He will reward the reliance. And He is All-Powerful over His servants, and He will requite the disbelievers, and the believer should rely on Him, and He will suffice him.

phrases.ar: إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَيَأۡتِ بِـَٔاخَرِينَۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرٗا
phrases.translation: If it is His Will, He can remove you altogether, O humanity, and replace you with others. And Allah is Most Capable to do so
phrases.explanation: "If it is His Will, He can do away with you altogether, O humanity, and bring others. And Allah is All-Powerful." Allah says if He wills, He can remove all people and bring others in their place, for He is All-Powerful over His servants, and He does what He wills. And the exegetes said the verse is a reminder of the power of Allah, that the believers should not be deceived by the disbelievers, for Allah can replace them, and He knows the wrongdoers, and He will requite them, and the believer should fear Allah and obey Him. And He can do all things. And He is All-Powerful.

phrases.ar: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ ثَوَابُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرٗا
phrases.translation: Whoever desires the reward of this world, then ˹let them know that˺ with Allah are the rewards of this world and the Hereafter. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing
phrases.explanation: "Whoever desires the reward of this world, then with Allah are the rewards of this world and the Hereafter. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing." Allah says whoever desires the reward of this worldly life, let him know that with Allah are the rewards of both this world and the Hereafter, and He gives whom He wills. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing, hearing the words and seeing the deeds, and He will requite the one who seeks the world and the one who seeks the Hereafter. And the exegetes discussed the verse and said it is a call to seek the Hereafter, for it is better and everlasting, and the believer should not be deceived by the world.

phrases.ar: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُواْ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَوِ ٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَۚ إِن يَكُنۡ غَنِيًّا أَوۡ فَقِيرٗا فَٱللَّهُ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهِمَاۖ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعۡدِلُواْۚ وَإِن
phrases.translation: O believers! Stand firm for justice as witnesses for Allah even if it is against yourselves, your parents, or close relatives. Be they rich or poor, Allah is best to ensure their interests. So do not let your desires cause you to deviate ˹from justice˺. If you distort the testimony or
phrases.explanation: "O believers! Stand firm for justice as witnesses for Allah, even if it is against yourselves, your parents, or close relatives. Do not let hatred of a people lead you to injustice. Be just, for that is closer to righteousness. Fear Allah, for Allah is All-Aware of what you do." Allah commands the believers to stand firm in justice, bearing witness for Allah even against themselves, their parents, or their kin, and not to let hatred of a people make them unjust. And justice is closer to piety, so be just, and fear Allah, for He is All-Aware of what you do. And the exegetes discussed the witness and said it is the testimony in judgment and in all affairs, and the believer should be just in word and deed, and Allah knows the just and the unjust, and He will requite them, and He loves the just. And the witness for Allah is the testimony given with truth, and the believer should bear witness in all his affairs, and not let kinship or enmity affect his testimony, for Allah is All-Seeing of the witnesses, and He will requite the truthful witness and punish the false one, and justice is the best of conduct, and the believer should be just with everyone, and Allah is All-Aware of what he does. And the believer should fear Allah in all his affairs. And standing firm in justice is a trust between the servant and his Lord, and Allah sees the witness, and the testimony against oneself is the hardest, and whoever does it, Allah will honor him, and reward him, and the believer should not fear the people in bearing witness for Allah, for Allah is with the believers.

phrases.ar: تَلۡوُۥٓاْ أَوۡ تُعۡرِضُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٗا
phrases.translation: refuse to give it, then ˹know that˺ Allah is certainly All-Aware of what you do
phrases.explanation: "Be just, for that is closer to righteousness. Fear Allah, for Allah is All-Aware of what you do." Justice is the closest of conduct to piety, and fearing Allah is the protection, and Allah is All-Aware of the hidden and the open, and He will reward the just, and the believer should fear Him in secret and in public. And the exegetes differed over the nearness of justice to piety, some saying it is the closest, and the believer should fear Allah in his justice, and Allah knows the hearts, and He will reward the just with the best of reward, and He is All-Aware of the hidden wrong, and He will requite it, and the believer should be just even against himself, for that is the proof of his faith and his fear of Allah. And do justice. And the exegetes said piety is fearing Allah in all affairs, and justice is part of it, and whoever is just, he is near to piety, and Allah loves the just, and He will admit them into Paradise, and He is All-Aware of what the servants do, and He will requite them, and nothing is hidden from Him. And He is All-Forgiving.

phrases.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ ءَامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِن قَبۡلُۚ وَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلَۢا بَعِيدًا
phrases.translation: O believers! Have faith in Allah, His Messenger, the Book He has revealed to His Messenger, and the Scriptures He revealed before. Indeed, whoever denies Allah, His angels, His Books, His messengers, and the Last Day has clearly gone far astray
phrases.explanation: "O believers! Have faith in Allah, His Messenger, the Book He has revealed to His Messenger, and the Book He revealed before. Whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has gone far astray." Allah commands the believers to believe in Allah, His Messenger, the Book revealed to him, and the books revealed before, and says whoever disbelieves in any of them has gone far astray. And the exegetes discussed the articles of faith and said they are the pillars, and whoever denies one of them is a disbeliever, and Allah knows the hearts, and He will requite the believer and the disbeliever, and the believer should hold fast to all the articles of faith.

phrases.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ
phrases.translation: Indeed, those who believed then disbelieved, then believed and again disbelieved—˹only˺
phrases.explanation: "Indeed, those who believed, then disbelieved, then believed and again disbelieved, and then increased in disbelief Allah will not forgive them, nor guide them to a way." Allah says those who oscillated between belief and disbelief, increasing in disbelief, will not be forgiven nor guided, for they toyed with the truth. And the exegetes differed over who is meant, but the meaning is that the one who dies in repeated disbelief after knowing the truth has no repentance accepted. And Allah knows who oscillates. And no path is open for them. And they increased in disbelief. And He will not forgive them. And He is All-Knowing. And He is All-Just.

phrases.ar: كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ ٱزۡدَادُواْ كُفۡرٗا لَّمۡ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا لِيَهۡدِيَهُمۡ سَبِيلَۢا
phrases.translation: increasing in disbelief—Allah will neither forgive them nor guide them to the ˹Right˺ Way
phrases.explanation: "Allah will not forgive them, nor guide them to a way." The door of repentance is closed for the one who persists in disbelief until death, and no path is open for him, and Allah knows the hearts, and He is All-Just, and He will requite them, and the believer should not delay repentance. And the exegetes differed over the oscillation and the forgiveness, and said the one who persists until death has no acceptance, and the believer should hasten to repentance and not toy with faith, for Allah is All-Knowing of the hearts, and He knows who is sincere, and He will requite each according to his deed, and the door of mercy is open until the soul reaches the throat. And Allah is All-Just. And the believer should hold fast to the faith and not oscillate, and seek the forgiveness of Allah, and Allah is All-Forgiving to those who repent sincerely, and He knows the sincere from the hypocrite, and He will judge between all with justice. And He knows the hearts. And whoever holds fast, he is saved. And Allah does what He wills.

phrases.ar: بَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
phrases.translation: Give good news of a painful punishment to hypocrites
phrases.explanation: "Give good news of a painful punishment to the hypocrites." Allah commands the Prophet to give the hypocrites the news of a painful punishment prepared for them, for their hypocrisy and their plotting. And the exegetes said the hypocrites will be in the lowest depth of the Fire, below the disbelievers, and Allah knows them, and He will requite them, and the believer should be sincere in his faith and not hypocritical. And the hypocrites will abide in it forever, and Allah knows their plotting, and He will expose them, and the believer should be sincere. And He is All-Knowing. And fear Allah. And He is All-Seeing.
